  • Collect structured feedback and translate it into recommendations for internal teams.
  • ork closely with Product, Sales, and Operations to improve solutions and customer experience.
  • Track KPIs and prepare reports on client health, satisfaction, and performance.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Marketing, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in commercial operations, preferably in Oil & Gas, energy, or industrial sectors.
  • Strong expertise in import/export, financial controls, and compliance processes.
  • Advanced skills in Excel and familiarity with CRM systems .
  • Experience with client/vendor portals is a strong plus.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese ;
    professional proficiency in English .
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and highly organized.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with strong presence in the Oil & Gas and energy sector.
  • Work in a strategic position that connects commercial, financial, and operational processes.
  • Gain exposure to international partners, clients, and suppliers.
  • Opportunities for career growth within Sales and Operations.
  • A collaborative and multicultural environment where your contributions make a real impact.


If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and play a critical role in driving sales operations at Belga Marine, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
Descrição do perfil

Responsável por analisar e interpretar grandes quantidades de dados de uma variedade de fontes, usando ferramentas algorítmicas, de mineração de dados, inteligência artificial, aprendizado de máquina e estatísticas, a fim de torná-los acessíveis à empresa.



Principais atividades

- Identificar, coletar, preparar, validar, analisar e interpretar dados relativos às várias atividades da organização para extrair informações, inclusive através do desenvolvimento de modelos preditivos e estatísticos para gerar sistemas avançados de aprendizagem e conhecimento organizado;

- Identificar e acessar as fontes de dados capazes de apoiar e desenvolver um determinado processo de negócios;

- Desenvolver protótipos e proof of concept em projetos de inovação utilizando ferramentas de desenvolvimento ágil;

- Supervisionar a inovação tecnológica e promover a sua aplicação através da elaboração de relatórios de prospecção tecnológica e análise de oportunidades, destacando as alternativas;

- Definir e aplicar modelos de análise de dados descritivos, preditivos e prescritivos com base nas necessidades de aplicação definidas;

- Identificar interpretar e manipular os conjuntos de dados necessários para o desenvolvimento dos modelos;

- Promover a aplicação de técnicas de aprendizado de máquina estatísticas corretas;

About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.

title: Webflow Designer
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com olhar apurado para produto digital, experiência do usuário e front-end em plataformas low-code/no-code como o Webflow , a LET'S é o seu lugar!


SOBRE A VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Webflow & Experiência Digital para liderar a evolução do nosso site, blog, landing pages e hubs de conteúdo — conectando marca, performance e produto em uma experiência consistente.


É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.


Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).
  • Implementação no Webflow : construir e manter páginas, layouts, coleções dinâmicas, formulários, interações, animações e variações responsivas (mobile-first).
  • Design System & consistência visual : organizar estilos globais (tipografia, cores, grids, componentes), garantindo coerência entre site, blog, LPs e materiais digitais.
  • Performance & SEO On-page : otimizar estrutura, headings, imagens, meta tags, URLs, links internos e boas práticas Core Web Vitals.
  • Integrações & low-code : configurar integrações com ferramentas como HubSpot, AirOps, n8n, WhatsApp/API, analytics, pixels e outros conectores sem depender sempre de dev.
  • Experimentação & conversão : propor e testar variações de páginas, CTAs, formulários e mensagens para melhorar conversão, engajamento e qualificação de leads.
  • Criação de estruturas de landing pages: desenvolver e criar modelos de landing pages escaláveis para eventos, material RICO, e outras formas de conteúdo.
  • Documentação & escalabilidade : registrar padrões, boas práticas e guidelines para que o ecossistema Webflow seja sustentável, organizado e fácil de evoluir.
  • Curiosidade técnica : explorar novas features, clonables, bibliotecas e soluções low-code/no-code que ajudem a levar o site “um passo além” sempre.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência comprovada (3+ anos) construindo sites, LPs e projetos profissionais em Webflow .
  • Domínio de UX/UI básico a intermediário : wireframes, hierarquia de informação, boas práticas de navegação e usabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML e CSS (para ajustar o que o Webflow gera e criar soluções mais refinadas).
  • Noções de JavaScript suficientes para pequenas interações, embeds e integrações simples.
  • Experiência com design responsivo e otimização para mobile.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de documentação técnica, tutoriais e comunidades (inclusive em inglês).
  • Perfil hands-on, curioso, autônomo , com vontade de testar, fuçar, perguntar (inclusive para IAs) e aprender rápido.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com Figma ou ferramenta similar para prototipação.
  • Familiaridade com integrações Webflow ↔ HubSpot , formulários, CRM, automações (n8n/Make/Zapier).
  • Conhecimento em SEO técnico , Analytics, Tag Manager e pixels.
  • Vivência com marcas B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile.
  • Noções de motion design (Lottie, microinterações, GSAP ou similar).
  • Noções de A/B testing , CRO e métricas de funil.
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário.


BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:

  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer

with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?


“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”


Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems


What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.


Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;

title: IT Security & Compliance Consultant
description:
About you

You are someone who provide security, compliance, and risk oversight and drive the creation of the detailed inventory and classification of installed applications—ensuring the taxonomy defined in the charter is implemented (name, version, publisher, category, description, EOL date, plus owner/team fields for future phases), data is normalized across Systems, and risks are surfaced with clear next steps.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred) or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5–7+ years of experience in security, compliance, or Software Asset Management (SAM) governance.
  • Hands-on experience with Intune, NinjaOne, and ServiceNow SAM.
  • Strong skills in data normalization, taxonomy design, and software lifecycle/EOL management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen eye for data quality and governance.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to coordinate across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to document processes, identify risks, and provide structured recommendations.
  • Advanced English proficiency to interact effectively with global stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Detailed Inventory Build (Installed Apps): Lead aggregation from multiple sources; reconcile source differences; produce a single authoritative baseline of applications and versions for workstations, mobile devices, and servers.
  • Classification & Taxonomy Execution: Implement the charter’s taxonomy fields (Application name, Version, Publisher, Category, Description, End-of-life date; define placeholders for Primary Business Owner, Technical Owner, Team using the application for future phases). Ensure every discovered app is categorized per the defined category scheme and platform (Win/Mac/iOS/Android/Server).
  • Normalization Rules: Define and apply deduplication and normalization (e.g., normalize publisher strings, collapse installer variants, consolidate minor version drift) so each entry represents a canonical application + version.
  • Quality & Coverage Checks: Establish data-quality gates (required fields populated for scope; minimal “Unknown publisher” entries; alignment of device coverage to endpoints in scope). Maintain an Excluded Items log for anything out-of-scope with rationale.
  • Security/EOL Enrichment: Add security-relevant attributes/workflows (EOL flagging, vulnerable/high-risk categories, privileged tools). Create a practical CVE lookup workflow for later phases; prioritize EOL and obviously risky categories.
  • Validation with Business: Facilitate validation sessions with Managing Directors/Dept Leads to confirm the catalog reflects reality; capture deltas and residual risks.
  • Risk Assessment & Inputs to Roadmap: Document findings (unsupported software, shadow IT indicators, risky categories) and quick wins that feed the implementation roadmap/policies (policy drafting is later-phase).


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Run reports in Looker Studio with performance analysis.

Proactively collaborate with SEO and client success managers to align campaign performance with business goals.

Familiar with Google Ads Manager, Google Ads Editor, GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, ClickUp, and Slack.

Focus on detail, with ability to follow SOPs 100% and identify opportunities for SOP refinement.

Excellent written English for writing ads, documentation, and communicating with cross-functional teams.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong personal standards for flawless execution.

Bonus Experience (not required): 


Experience with Local Service Ads management 

Unbounce 

Experience optimizing paid campaigns for service-based lead generation

Experience with WhatConverts or CallRail 

What We Value  


Data-Driven Execution – Campaigns are backed by analytics, SOPs, and real-time data.

Ownership & Accountability – We don’t micromanage. We hire A-players who take pride in precision and results.

Proactive Communication – Solutions-oriented communication that is clear and timely across departments and time zones.

Fast-Paced Execution – Weekly optimizations and QA routines are non-negotiable.

Continuous Improvement – We are always refining our systems to push performance higher.

Success Metrics 


Zero critical errors found in QA across all campaigns.

100% of weekly optimization routines completed on time.

Campaign pacing within ±5% of budget plan. 

Negative keyword coverage improves irrelevant query share quarter-over-quarter.

Reporting completeness rate 95%+ as measured by manager audit.

Compensation, Benefits, and Schedule 


Base Salary: $1,200–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience and skill level.

Schedule: Flexible work hours but must be available for mandatory 4-hour team overlap for collaboration with cross-department teams.

Multi-Step Hiring Process 


We’re serious about hiring because we’re serious about building a team of disciplined executors who thrive in a high-performance culture.

Application and screening questions.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

Why Downstream

title: Técnico em Lubrificação Sênior
description:

Efetua os serviços de verificação de nível e reposição de lubrificantes em equipamentos;

Realiza a inspeção dos equipamentos, relativos à função lubrificação;

Efetua a troca de cargas de lubrificantes, bem como a sua purificação e filtragem;

Lubrifica os pontos de graxa e verifica o funcionamento em sistemas centralizados;

Efetua a lubrificação de correntes, guias, articulações, engrenagens, acoplamentos;

Cumpre a programação periódica de inspeção e lubrificação;

Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;

Efetua a substituição de elementos filtrantes;

Faz a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

Limpeza específica de unidades hidráulicas;

Segrega lubrificantes usados, elementos filtrantes e desengraxantes para descarte;

Segue as instruções de trabalho e procedimentos inerentes à sua função, quando estas existirem;

Executa outras tarefas correlatas às descritas, a critério do superior imediato;

Análise dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes das análises dos lubrificantes;

Execução das práticas adequadas para coleta de amostras de lubrificantes;

Garantir a confiabilidade das Unidades Hidráulicas e de lubrificação (elementos filtrantes, nível de contaminação, pontos de coleta de amostras, etc);

Seguir, monitorar e garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente da SKF e dos clientes

Garantir que os equipamentos rotativos das unidades fabris dos clientes não quebrem em emergência

Garantir os padrões da qualidade das Normas e Procedimentos ISO

Elaboração e revisão dos planos de Lubrificação Industrial

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.

Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação. Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.

Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de trabalho em equipe.

Compromisso com a segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

  • Localization Quality: Oversee and improve translation quality for localized content (e.g., pt-BR) across app, website, and marketing assets.

  • 2+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Growth, Digital Marketing, or related roles.

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;

title: Creative Strategist
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re a fast-growing consumer brand group selling across e-commerce, TikTok Shop, and Amazon. We prioritize direct-response strategy, product quality, and measurable efficacy. The team moves fast and operates with a high bar.


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We’re hiring a Creative Strategist with heavy direct response experience.


You’ll own both strategy and ops: building and briefing angles, scripting iterations, managing sprints, reviewing edits, and ensuring we ship 100–200 ads per week.


You must have lived and breathed direct response advertising and VSL-style creative—knowing the beats, pacing, proof, and psychology that drive conversions. This is a hands-on IC role with pod-level ownership (no formal people management).


Focus split:

● ~60% Strategy/Briefing

● ~40% Creative Ops/QA/Delivery


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


WHAT WILL YOU DO?


Direct Response Strategy / Briefing / Analysis

● Develop a creative strategy by offer, funnel, and awareness stage; publish weekly test plans.

● Generate net-new DR angles from learnings, competitor swipes, and cultural trends.

● Outline 2–3 minute VSL-style ads (problem, agitation, solution, proof, CTA) and collaborate with copy on scripting.

● Write iteration briefs (hook swaps, lead/body edits, CTA tests, packaging, captions) with clear hypotheses.

● Brief content creators with DR talking tracks, shot lists, compliance guardrails, and demo guidelines.

● Lead reviews to ensure DR structure, pacing, and storytelling are dialed in.

● Translate performance data (Hook, Hold, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS) into new test briefs within 1–3 days.


Creative Ops & Delivery

● Own weekly sprints: intake → brief → production → QA → launch → iteration.

● Plan and ship 100–200 ads weekly (mix of new and iterations).

● Traffic assets correctly: naming, specs (9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1), captions, UTMs.

● QA assets for typos, compliance, pacing, audio, and render quality.

● Review editor work with time-stamped, DR-specific notes (cut logic, proof beats, motion/graphics, sound).

● Maintain a clean, searchable DAM with version control.

● Coordinate with Media/Growth to ensure launches hit deadlines.

● Use light automation/AI for cut-downs, resizing, and captions.

● Track throughput and ensure weekly volume targets are met without errors.

● Manage creator usage rights and content expirations.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

● 100–200 DR ads shipped weekly , >98% QA pass rate .

● Iterations launched within 24–48 hours of insights , increasing win rate.

● Faster time-to-first-winner and more winners per 50 launches.

● A standardized system for DR briefs (VSL, creator, iteration) used by the team.

● Clean DAM and clear creative pipeline visible to Growth/Media .


MUST-HAVES

● 3+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in high-spend environments ($1MM+/mo).

● Deep experience with VSL-style ads : structure, beats, proof, pacing, CTA flow.

● Proven ability to ship 100–200 ads weekly across VSLs, short-form, and UGC.

● Strong post-production literacy (Premiere/Final Cut/AE basics) for precise DR feedback.

● Track record of writing/briefing iterations and content creators for DR assets .

● Data-driven mindset; you live in Hook/Hold/CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS.

● Detail-oriented; errors don’t slip past you.

● Clear communicator who pushes creative toward DR performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

● Health, beauty, or OTC-adjacent experience.

● Amazon and TikTok Shop creative systems.

● Familiarity with tools: ClickUp/Asana, Frame.io, Motion/Varos, Google Workspace, CapCut/Descript, Runway/Topaz/ElevenLabs

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender

Junte-se a nós!

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale.   • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicativos SAP Fiori/UI5 voltados a processos de benefícios (adesão, consulta, alteração e cancelamento);
  • Criar e consumir serviços OData via SAP Gateway , integrando as aplicações Fiori aos dados do SRH;
  • Colaborar com consultores funcionais de RH para entendimento das regras de negócio (ex.: infotypes 0167, 0168, 0171);
  • Implementar extensões em aplicativos padrão SAP Fiori (“Meus Benefícios”, “Gerenciar Benefícios”);
  • Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes de UX/UI do SAP Fiori Design Guidelines ;
  • Realizar testes técnicos e funcionais , assegurando performance e segurança dos dados;
  • Publicar e gerenciar aplicativos no Fiori Launchpad (catálogos, grupos e roles);
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, review, retrospectiva) em conjunto com times funcionais, ABAP e de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Fiori e SAPUI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, XML, controllers, models);
  • Domínio em OData Services (criação, consumo e troubleshooting);
  • Conhecimento em ABAP OO para suporte às integrações com SRH;
  • Vivência com SAP Gateway (SEGW) e configuração de serviços;
  • Experiência com Fiori Launchpad , perfis de acesso (PFCG) e transportes SAP;
  • Domínio das ferramentas SAP Web IDE ou Business Application Studio (BAS) ;
  • Entendimento básico de Fiori Elements, Smart Controls e Theme Designer ;
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento dos processos funcionais de Benefícios (BEN) dentro do SRH (planos de saúde, previdência, dependentes, reembolsos);
  • Entendimento dos infotypes 0167, 0168, 0170, 0171 ;
  • Experiência em extensão de aplicativos padrão SAP ;
  • Familiaridade com DevOps, Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban );
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP , CAP ou desenvolvimento em ambientes cloud .



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Especialista em segurança
description:
A Stone está com uma oportunidade em seu time de Segurança em Desenvolvimento (AppSec) na área de Segurança da Informação para trabalhar com foco em projetos de Inteligência Artificial, em especial interfaces conversacionais! Você gosta de buscar novos desafios e adquirir novos conhecimentos para acelerar o desenvolvimento de carreira? Se sim, venha fazer parte do nosso time de Segurança da Informação, como Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior na Stone!

O time de AppSec tem como propósito garantir que os aplicativos sejam desenvolvidos, mantidos e utilizados de maneira segura e protegida contra ameaças cibernéticas. Buscamos evitar que nossos sistemas tenham vulnerabilidades que possam ser exploradas por criminosos cibernéticos, visando proteger dados sensíveis, a privacidade dos usuários e a integridade das aplicações.


Como é ser Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior?


Dentre as atividades de trabalho esperadas, estão:


Estratégia, Colaboração e Arquitetura Segura em IA:

  • Ser o ponto focal de segurança, colaborando diretamente com times de engenharia em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Participar e conduzir ativamente revisões de arquitetura para sistemas baseados em IA, desde a concepção até a fase de produção.
  • Realizar threat modeling específico para identificar e mitigar vetores de ataque exclusivos de sistemas de IA.
  • Desenvolver e manter um programa de segurança, abrangendo atividades defensivas e ofensivas, para aplicações de Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI).

Domínio de Riscos e Vulnerabilidades de Segurança em IA:

  • Possuir profundo conhecimento em riscos de segurança e privacidade específicos de IA, incluindo (mas não limitado a) o OWASP Top 10 for LLMs :
  • Prompt Injection e técnicas de jailbreak.
  • Insecure Output Handling e riscos de execução de código.
  • Data Poisoning em datasets de treino/fine-tuning.
  • Model Denial of Service e ataques de exaustão de recursos.
  • Vulnerabilidades na cadeia de suprimentos (Supply Chain) de modelos, dados e dependências.
  • Vazamento de Informações Sensíveis (Sensitive Information Disclosure).
  • Insecure Plugin Design e riscos associados a tool/function calling.
  • Excessive Agency em sistemas e agentes autônomos.
  • Ataques de Inversão de Modelo e Inferência de Membro (Model Inversion/Membership Inference Attacks).
  • Roubo de Modelo (Model Theft).

Segurança em Arquiteturas e Componentes Específicos de IA:

  • Avaliação de Pipelines RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation): Foco em segurança de Vector databases, embeddings, estratégias de chunking e manipulação/injeção de contexto.
  • Revisão de Sistemas de Agentes Autônomos: Análise de limites de execução de tools/functions, segurança de memória/contexto persistente do agente e transparência de raciocínio (chain-of-thought).
  • Protocolos e Integrações: Avaliar a segurança do Model Context Protocol (MCP) e integrações.
  • Fluxos de Fine-tuning: Analisar workflows de fine-tuning e riscos de injeção de backdoors.
  • Controles de Segurança: Validar a implementação de guardrails e sistemas de filtragem de conteúdo (content filtering).

Governança, Compliance e Maturidade em IA:

  • Aplicar frameworks de avaliação de maturidade em segurança de IA (ex: OWASP AI Maturity Assessment).
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações emergentes (ex: AI Act, Executive Orders) e suas implicações técnicas.
  • Implementar controles de privacidade diferencial e minimização de dados.
  • Estabelecer políticas de governança de modelos e versionamento seguro.

Capacidades Técnicas e Operacionais:

  • Ciclo de Vida de LLMs: Conhecimento aprofundado em pre-training, fine-tuning, RLHF, alignment, padrões de deployment (API-based, on-premise, edge) e implicações de segurança do prompt engineering.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar a detecção de model drift, bias drift, concept drift e métricas de segurança (ex: toxicity scores, jailbreak attempts, PII leakage). Realizar anomaly detection e auditoria de prompts e outputs.
  • Infraestrutura de IA em Cloud: Experiência com serviços gerenciados de LLM (ex: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI), segurança de containers para workloads de ML/AI, gerenciamento de segredos (secrets management) e isolamento de rede.

Testes e Validação de Segurança:

  • Conduzir security assessments de aplicações baseadas em LLM utilizando metodologias específicas.
  • Realizar exercícios simulando ataques como prompt injection, jailbreak, cenários de exfiltração de dados e adversarial inputs.
  • Validar controles de rate limiting, prevenção de abuso e gerenciamento de custos.
  • Testar sandboxing e isolamento para execução de código.


Outras Contribuições e Habilidades:

  • Avaliar riscos e definir requisitos e padrões de segurança.
  • Realizar revisões de código e design de arquitetura.
  • Implementar testes de segurança automatizados e auxiliar na mitigação e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Promover o treinamento e a sensibilização dos times de desenvolvimento.
  • Integrar segurança de forma eficiente nos processos de desenvolvimento (shift-left).
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências de segurança em IA.
  • Utilizar a experiência e intuição de segurança para buscar ameaças nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.
  • Ter iniciativa para buscar ou solicitar dados importantes que estejam ausentes.
  • Desenvolver soluções criativas e complexas que equilibrem riscos e necessidades de negócio.
  • Capacidade plena de leitura e comunicação eficiente em inglês.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Ter capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhorias, novas soluções e alertas que possam beneficiar e/ou facilitar a operação
  • Usar habilidades de influência e negociação para direcionar os times a corrigirem problemas ou a utilizar arquiteturas adequadas do ponto de vista de segurança
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis, com foco em integração, transformação e governança de dados na plataforma Snowflake.

Projetar e implementar soluções de ingestão e orquestração utilizando Azure Data Factory, Databricks e outras ferramentas do ecossistema Azure.

Integrar dados de diferentes fontes (REST, SOAP, OData APIs), garantindo a qualidade, consistência e performance dos processos.

Modelar dados corporativos com boas práticas de modelagem relacional (E/R, normalização, chaves primárias e estrangeiras).

Administrar e versionar código por meio do GitHub e CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), aplicando automação e boas práticas de deploy.

Gerenciar componentes da infraestrutura Azure, como Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, Logic Apps e Azure Functions.

Monitorar performance, custos e qualidade dos pipelines, aplicando tunning e melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Colaborar com times globais em ambiente ágil, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.


O que você precisa ter

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Data Engineer, com atuação prática em desenvolvimento de pipelines e soluções de dados em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Azure Data Factory, Snowflake e Databricks, com experiência em integração, transformação e governança de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL, incluindo transformação, otimização e performance tuning.
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados e manipulação de dados semiestruturados (JSON, XML, Parquet).
  • Vivência com CI/CD, GitHub Actions e práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Sólida compreensão da infraestrutura Azure (Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, monitoramento, Azure Functions).
  • Experiência com orquestração e agendamento de jobs (ADF triggers, Logic Apps, FiveTran).
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente internacional.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e atuação em times multifuncionais.

Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.

Optimization and Allocation Systems

Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools

Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. title: Contracting Manager (Activities & Experiences)
description:
Contracting Manager (supplier negotiations)

Location – Brazil

Full Time


About Us

HBX Group is the world’s leading technological partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard-to-reach high-value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course, we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality.


Job Summary:

As the face of HBX Group to our suppliers, you will develop strong relationships with our suppliers for a defined portfolio of activities within a specific geographic area.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the contracting process with our clients in a B2B and B2C environment, focused on signing the most competitive rates for HBX Group.
  • Negotiate contract renewal conditions such as: rate, inventory, offers, release periods, marketing contributions, overrides, cancellation policy.
  • Monitor the performance of each hotel working closely with the Yield Manager to ensure competitiveness and availability is not an issue.
  • Act as the face-to-face key point contact for experienced suppliers and develop and maintain excellent relationships with them.
  • Support the resolution of major supplier or client complaints, negotiating the most suitable solution to maintain good service and a positive relationship with them.
  • Ensure the supplier has a clear understanding of HBX Group value proposition and marketing tools to optimize the income of each contract.


Skillset and Experience Required:

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in contracting and supplier management within the travel or activities industry.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.
  • Proficiency in relevant software tools and systems.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish additional languages are a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

Key Responsibilities :

1 Culinary Training & Development :

◦ Develop and execute the ship’s overall Culinary Training & Development strategy for all Culinary crew members with 2 or fewer stripes.

◦ Ensure understanding and delivery of the company’s service standards, training materials, operational practices, and rating systems for the Culinary Department.

◦ Conduct relevant training and follow-up audits to ensure these standards are being met consistently.

2 Collaboration with Senior Culinary Leadership :

◦ Assist the Executive Chef and Executive Sous Chef in identifying crew members with the potential for career advancement.

◦ Collaborate with leadership to evaluate crew members who may not meet the required skill set or attitude and determine their future role within the team.

◦ Provide ongoing training on company standards and best practices to all culinary employees.

◦ Conduct role-play sessions and hands-on training for crew members at their respective workstations.

◦ Offer constructive feedback during coaching sessions and performance audits.

◦ Create daily training schedules and feedback reports, presenting them to the Executive Chef.

◦ Organize and execute daily daytime training sessions (45 minutes per group) for crew members on port days, ensuring relevant performance, revenue, and ratings data inform participant selection.

◦ Conduct nightly follow-up performance audits and provide feedback to the crew members and the Executive Chef.

5 Performance Audits & One-on-One Coaching :

◦ Conduct performance audits and coaching sessions during sea days, providing feedback to both crew members and management.

◦ Identify low performers and work with the Executive Chef to create improvement plans for those who may require additional training or support.

◦ Coach and mentor Chef de Cuisine, Sous Chefs, and Chef de Partie on effectively conducting training sessions, including facility setup, session flow, feedback delivery, and session evaluation.

Possesses culinary expertise, formal education, and practical experience in the culinary field.

Having culinary training and certificates is a plus.

Job Title: L2 Security Engineer - EDR Solutions (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne)

Location: Hybrid, 24x7 Shifts

Job Type: Full-Time (Rotational Shift Model, including weekends and holidays)


Job Summary:

As an L2 Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of EDR solutions by monitoring platform health, enforcing security policies, and troubleshooting endpoint issues across multiple EDR platforms including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. Your role includes onboarding devices, validating security rules, handling basic policy enforcement issues, and ensuring that all endpoints remain compliant with security baselines. You will assist in resolving connectivity issues, missing telemetry cases, and agent health checks while escalating complex platform-related problems to L3.


Key Responsibilities:

· Ensure endpoints are successfully onboarded to EDR solutions across all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

· Monitor endpoint connectivity and health status within the EDR portals.

· Validate that security rules, EDR, and antivirus policies are applied correctly.

· Assist in troubleshooting policy conflicts and enforcement issues.

· Investigate and validate EDR alerts, classify threats, and escalate incidents if required.

· Apply basic remediation steps like isolating devices, initiating scans, or triggering automated investigations.

· Identify endpoints not reporting telemetry or experiencing EDR agent failures.

· Perform basic troubleshooting (e.g., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity).

· Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3.

· Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management.

· Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates.

· Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions.

· Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents.


Required Skills & Knowledge:

· Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne.

· Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately.

· Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred).

· Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.


Work Environment & Shift Requirements:

· 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment.

· Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams.


Preferred Certifications:

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)

· Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

· SentinelOne Certified Administrator


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint

  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Amazon FBA Sourcing Specialist
description:
Purchasing / Sourcing Specialist (Full-Time / USD)


Location: Remote

Compensation: USD $1,800–$2,300/month (depending on experience and scope)

Working Hours: 6 AM – 2 PM EST or at least 6 hours overlap within this window


About the Role

We’re seeking a detail-oriented and cost-conscious Purchasing / Sourcing Specialist to manage and optimize supplier relationships for our Amazon private-label and marketplace operations.

You’ll lead sourcing and negotiations with manufacturers, build landed cost models, and oversee end-to-end execution across samples, purchase orders, and logistics. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with operational rigor — ensuring smooth, margin-focused supply chain performance from factory to FBA/3PL.


Key Responsibilities

  • Source, vet, and onboard manufacturers; run RFQs and negotiate pricing, MOQs, lead times, and payment terms.
  • Build and maintain accurate landed cost models, factoring in duties, freight, and FBA fees to achieve margin targets.
  • Coordinate product samples, specifications, labeling, packaging, and compliance with Amazon and category standards.
  • Create and track POs from production through delivery; ensure on-time, in-full (OTIF) supplier and carrier performance.
  • Monitor vendor performance (cost, quality, lead time, defect rate) and lead corrective actions as needed.
  • Conduct supplier audits and risk assessments (geopolitical, compliance, capacity).
  • Identify and execute cost-saving initiatives through negotiation, packaging optimization, or alternate sourcing.
  • Drive continuous improvement in sourcing processes and supplier performance.


✅ Requirements

  • 3+ years in purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain management, ideally within Amazon FBA or e-commerce.
  • Proven experience negotiating with overseas factories (pricing, MOQs, payment terms).
  • Strong understanding of landed cost analysis, margins, and Amazon’s fee structures.
  • Knowledge of quality control checkpoints and product compliance.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with PO or ERP systems preferred.
  • Highly organized, with strong documentation and multi-SKU project management ability.
  • Proactive, analytical, and comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Helium 10, Keepa, or other sourcing/market analysis tools.
  • Experience with EDI, inventory planning, or demand forecasting.
  • Exposure to regulated product categories or Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence

title: DBA SQL Server
description:
A Conquest One é uma empresa especializada em Staffing de Tecnologia da Informação, que trabalha há 25 anos oferecendo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis de outsourcing e hunting aos seus clientes, ajudando cada um deles nos seus desafios de forma única e exclusiva. Bancos de Dados

  • Administração avançada de Microsoft SQL Server ;
  • Experiência com Azure SQL Database , Managed Instance e Synapse Analytics ;
  • Conhecimento de Cosmos DB e Data Lake .


Cloud e Infraestrutura

  • Experiência em ambientes 100% Cloud ;
  • Familiaridade com Azure Policy, RBAC, Key Vault e gestão de identidades .

Alta Disponibilidade e Recuperação

  • Configuração e manutenção de Always On , Geo-Replication e backup automatizado ;
  • Planejamento e execução de testes de contingência e restore .


Performance e Tuning

  • Proficiência em execution plans , AWR/ADDM , Query Store , index tuning e diagnóstico de performance ;

Automação e DevOps

  • Experiência com PowerShell, Terraform, Azure DevOps e CI/CD para bancos de dados;
  • Implementação de pipelines de deploy automatizado e infraestrutura como código (IaC).


Monitoramento e Observabilidade

  • Experiência com Azure Monitor , Log Analytics , Grafana e Prometheus ;

Integração e Big Data

  • Vivência com Azure Data Factory , SSIS e integração com Data Lake / Synapse ;
  • Desejável conhecimento em modelos analíticos e arquitetura de dados moderna (Lakehouse, Databricks).


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Microsoft DP-300 , AZ-305 ;
  • Conhecimento em Oracle , PostgreSQL e MySQL no Azure;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (AKS) e containers ;
  • Conhecimento em machine learning aplicado a bancos de dados ;
  • Residência preferencial: Rio de Janeiro.

Perfil Desejado

Profissional proativo, colaborativo e orientado a resultados, com capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambientes complexos.

Deve ter visão de arquitetura, foco em performance e comprometimento com disponibilidade e segurança da informação .

description:

About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and
