title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

Requirements:

  • Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API design.

title: Researcher
description:
Join Bentham Science Publishers as a Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal , "Current Alzheimer Research "


If you're interested in publishing your Research, click here.



Position Overview:

We invite researchers and scientists to join us as Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal,

"Current Alzheimer Research" , to contribute to a research area (section) most relevant to their field of expertise.


The candidates for the Guest Topical Issue Editor position should have a proven track record of scholarly publishing and organizing a Topical Issue, and they should be able to assemble a collection of high-quality research/review articles related to their section.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing a comprehensive proposal for a special issue, highlighting its importance and detailing prospective contributors.
  • Collaborating with possible co-editors to effectively organize the special issue and coordinate with authors, ensuring a smooth editorial process.
  • Inviting contributors from diverse regions, focusing on those with a proven publication record.
  • Promoting the special issue to enhance its visibility and impact.


*The Article Processing Charges (APC) are offered with a discount to facilitate Open Access publishing by the authors.


Qualifications and Experience:

• Ph.D. in related fields

• A valid Scopus ID.

• Prior experience in publishing guest-edited thematic issues in peer-reviewed journals.

• They must have a list of scholarly authors who can consent to contribute research / review articles in the thematic issue(s) proposed by the Topical Issue.

• Strong networks within the research community.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Familiarity with scientific publication and peer review processes.


Benefits:

• An honorarium to support thematic issue promotion and academic & research endeavors.

• Rapid publication of the special issue, with articles going online within 30 days of acceptance.

• Full APC waiver for an article authored by the Topical Issue.

• A free online subscription to all articles published in the journal during the year.


Location:

This is a remote opportunity, offering flexibility and convenience.


How To Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CVs; list of publications, and a Topical issue proposal by 25 December 2025. The proposal should include the title and scope of the Topical issue, relevant keywords, sub-topics, and preferably, the article titles, a list of potential contributors, and article submission deadlines.


Special Instructions:

• Each author/co-author is welcome to contribute one paper to the Topical Issue.

• Contributions must adhere to topics approved by the Editor-in-Chief.

• Manuscript submission extensions will be limited to 60 days.


Additional Offer:

In our ongoing efforts to expand our Editorial team, we are pleased to offer the successful Guest Editors a potential for advancement within the Editorial Board. Based on qualifications and contributions, outstanding editors may be considered for prestigious positions on our Editorial Board.


*The provision of Scopus ID is a MUST for the application to be shortlisted.

title: Analista de negócios e sistemas de TI
description:
Modelo de trabalho: híbrido 2x por semana no escritório

Localização: Escritório Central I Rio de Janeiro

Regime de contratação: CLT + benefícios



Buscamos um(a) profissional para ser o canal de comunicação entre a área de tecnologia e as áreas de negócio. O objetivo é protagonizar uma atuação colaborativa, definindo, propondo, desenvolvendo, implantando e mantendo soluções tecnológicas (aplicações) que atendam às necessidades e agreguem valor ao negócio.

A posição demanda sólida experiência em desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de aplicações baseadas na plataforma .NET , atuando em ambientes corporativos com arquiteturas modernas e escaláveis. É essencial dominar as boas práticas de engenharia de software, com foco em qualidade, performance, segurança e manutenção.


Principais atribuições e responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a concepção de soluções de tecnologia (aplicações, mudanças de processo, soluções de infraestrutura e operativas).
  • Coordenar o processo de relacionamento com as áreas de negócio, obtendo domínio sobre os temas, colaborando na evolução tecnológica e organizando as necessidades dos clientes para as iniciativas de TI.
  • Desenvolver novas iniciativas e projetos de desenvolvimento de software, além de conduzir a manutenção das soluções (aplicações) existentes.
  • Coordenar os processos de implantação, testes e homologação relacionados às soluções de tecnologia.
  • Coordenar as políticas, procedimentos e normas de tecnologia junto aos seus interlocutores.
  • Atuar de forma propositiva e prestar atendimento direto aos usuários dos sistemas.
  • Realizar o levantamento de requisitos junto aos usuários (seja de bugs ou novas demandas).
  • Conduzir a análise inicial de problemas/novas implementações (depurar sistema, propor soluções, avaliar dados, brainstorm e negociação com fábricas de software e arquitetura).
  • Realizar build e deploy de versões.
  • Gerenciar branches de desenvolvimento.
  • Administrar a esteira (sistemas em servidores tradicionais e em PODs - OpenShift).
  • Auxiliar na validação de estimativas.


Requisitos:

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciências da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas.
  • Experiência: Experiência acumulada a partir de 9 anos.



Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • C# .Net (Core e Framework).
  • Angular e/ou React.
  • Modelagem de Banco de dados (preferencialmente Microsoft SQL) e linguagem SQL.
  • Mensageria (preferencialmente Kafka).
  • Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.
  • Engenharia de software com ênfase em metodologias de desenvolvimento (tradicionais e ágeis).


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Especialização: MBA ou Pós-graduação em Engenharia, Ciências da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos:
  • Engenharia de processos.
  • Container (Kubernets, Docker e/ou Openshift).
  • Disciplinas de ALM e Automação.
  • RPA (Automation Anywhere) ou similares.
  • Arquitetura Corporativa e de Negócio.
  • Habilidades Analíticas (incluindo desenvolvimento de painéis em PowerBI/Tableau).


Competências comportamentais esperadas:

  • Colaboração
  • Foco nos Resultados
  • Inspira Confiança
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Comunicação Eficiente
  • Inovação
  • Entendimento Organizacional
  • Gerenciamento da Complexidade
  • Orientação para a Ação
  • Otimização de Processos
  • Resiliência

description:

Oferecemos soluções de contratação para posições temporárias, permanentes e de contrato para efetivação em áreas como tecnologia, finanças e contabilidade, engenharia, marketing e criação, serviços jurídicos, suporte administrativo e ao cliente, energia, petróleo e gás, telecomunicações, manufatura, aeroespacial, ciências da vida, mineração e utilidades.

Na SGF Global, trabalhamos para colocá-lo na melhor posição para ter sucesso. Oferecemos acesso a posições de alto nível, remuneração competitiva, benefícios atrativos e treinamentos online gratuitos.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: US Tax & Accounting Specialist – Foreign-Owned & Domestic Entities (100% Remote)
description:
About Us

At Space Financial Group, we help entrepreneurs from the US, Latin America, Brazil, and worldwide set up and run U.S. companies the right way. We specialize in LLCs, S-Corps, tax compliance, bookkeeping, and Virtual CFO services for both foreign-owned U.S. entities and traditional American clients.

We’re growing fast and need an experienced, detail-oriented accounting and tax professional who loves solving complex cross-border puzzles and delivering peace of mind to clients.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file U.S. federal (and some state) tax returns for:

- Single-member & multi-member LLCs (Form 1065, Schedule K-1)

- S-Corporations (Form 1120-S, K-1s)

- Foreign-owned U.S. disregarded entities and corporations (Form 5472, 1120)

- U.S. individual tax returns (Form 1040, 1040-NR for non-residents)

  • Manage monthly/quarterly bookkeeping and financial statement preparation using QuickBooks Online
  • Oversee payroll compliance when applicable
  • Advise clients (in Spanish, Portuguese, or English) on tax-saving strategies, entity structuring, BOI reporting (FinCEN), and compliance timelines
  • Review and correct client-provided records, flag red flags, and ensure data accuracy
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based CPAs/Enrolled Agents on complex cases while owning day-to-day execution


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent U.S. tax preparation experience with partnerships, S-Corps, and individuals
  • Practical experience with foreign-owned U.S. entities (Form 5472, 1120) is a strong plus
  • Solid background preparing Form 1040 for U.S. citizens/residents
  • Mastery of QuickBooks Online (QBO)
  • Advanced Excel skills and ability to build models or schedules
  • Fluency in Spanish , English , and Portuguese


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are…

  • Extremely organized and deadline-driven
  • Great at simplifying complex tax concepts across different languages
  • Curious about cross-border legal and tax structures
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently
  • Proactive – you spot problems before the IRS does


Compensation & Benefits

  • R$6,000 – R$9,000 BRL/month (depending on experience & certifications)
  • 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • Paid time off
  • Annual training/conference budget

title: Power BI Analyst/Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você fará parte do time que atende uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , contribuindo em iniciativas estratégicas com foco em métricas, governança de dados e apoio à tomada de decisão.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI para suporte a indicadores de negócio.
  • Criar e otimizar modelos de dados utilizando DAX e Power Query (M).
  • Integrar dados de diferentes fontes como Excel, Smartsheet, SQL Server, SharePoint e Azure.
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados utilizados nas soluções de BI.
  • Levantar requisitos com stakeholders e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas.
  • Documentar regras de negócio, fontes de dados e padrões de modelagem.
  • Apoiar usuários com treinamento e habilitação para autosserviço.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e melhorias contínuas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre novas funcionalidades e boas práticas em Power BI.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Power BI
  • Proficiência em DAX, Power Query (M) e modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com SQL e bancos relacionais.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Data Warehouse e ETL.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e alinhamento com áreas de negócio.
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas em um ambiente dinâmico.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com serviços de dados Azure (como Azure SQL e Data Factory).
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos e times multifuncionais.
  • Experiência em storytelling com dados ou governança de dados.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. You’ll turn ideas into impactful solutions by connecting business goals, user needs, and technical execution. This role focuses on defining vision, setting priorities, and delivering products that drive growth, innovation, and long-term value across emerging technologies and financial ecosystems.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new product opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from users, partners, and internal stakeholders to inform product design and prioritization.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, balancing priorities and timelines across multiple initiatives.


Execution and Delivery

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create user-centric designs and intuitive experiences.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution of product features and releases.
  • Lead product launches, define success metrics, and coordinate enablement with marketing, sales, and support teams.


Performance and Improvement

  • Monitor product performance post-launch, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure all product features adhere to regulatory requirements in the crypto and financial services space.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment, ensuring all teams are informed, empowered, and accountable.
  • Support documentation, go-to-market readiness, and internal communication for each product phase.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in fintech or financial services, with direct crypto experience.
  • Demonstrated success of launching and scaling successful web and/or enterprise products from concept to launch.
  • Experience with varying development methodologies and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, fintech, or emerging financial technologies preferred.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision making using metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical conversations.
  • High user empathy, strong prioritization abilities, and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.



The ROLE

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.


This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:


  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).

  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust: Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
  • Growth Opportunities: We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
  • Collaborative Support: We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
  • Diversity of Stories: Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition: We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
  • Open Organization: We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

title: Java Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Java Developer to join our international team. We deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and distributed development teams.


About the Role:


As a Java Developer , you will work on the design, development, and maintenance of Java-based applications that support key business functions. A strong command of Java 8 and hands-on experience with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) are essential for this role, as you will be deeply involved in log validation, performance optimization, and application stability.

This position is ideal for a professional who thrives in an agile, collaborative environment and enjoys solving complex technical challenges across multiple applications.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Java 8 applications using Spring Framework (Spring 4.1.3 and Spring Security 3.2.5).
  • Lead and participate in application migration projects , with a focus on optimizing and validating logs in ELK .
  • Implement and fine-tune Elasticsearch indexing, querying, and data retrieval for high-performance applications.
  • Maintain and enhance front-end components using JSP, jQuery, and AngularJS .
  • Configure and deploy applications on Tomcat servers , ensuring reliability outside OpenShift environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to manage approximately 40 applications , maintaining stability and version consistency.
  • Utilize Azure DevOps templates for CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement and maintain automated smoke tests for proactive issue detection.


Required Qualifications:


  • Expert-level experience with Java 8 and Spring Frameworks (Spring 4.1.3, Spring Security 3.2.5).
  • Proven expertise working with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log management, validation, and performance analysis.
  • Strong understanding of Tomcat server configuration and deployments.
  • Experience developing scalable applications with Spring Boot 1.5.x .
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps and automated testing frameworks .
  • Solid knowledge of UI frameworks (JSP, jQuery, AngularJS).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging, log validation, and application migration.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively in distributed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Technology , or related field (or equivalent experience).


Preferred Qualifications:


  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development , Computer Science , or Computer Engineering .
  • Additional experience in client-facing roles or international projects.

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?


“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."


Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer


What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.


This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.


This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.


What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Sr Product Owner
description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.


We are #EnergizedByGrowth.


DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United Stat.


Summary

Responsible for software development projects for payment terminals and embedded media for Latin America.


Detailed Description Of The Activities

  • Rapid understanding and development of new functions in the payment software platform, DFS embedded media products.
  • Represent stakeholders during the project and monitor projects with customers (internal and/or external).
  • Organize and plan the product backlog, conducting meetings with stakeholders to prioritize the items to be developed whenever necessary.
  • Responsible for the decisions of which teamwork will maximize the value of the product and add more to those involved, sets goals, prioritizes and approves quality, always seeking to ensure the highest return on investment.
  • Maintain the agile management principles followed by the team, supporting the Scrum processes with the team (daily, planning, review and retrospective), Kanban and other applicable methods.
  • Assist the commercial teams in the presentation of existing or new products, understanding of new demands and support in the generation of commercial proposals for specific new projects or improvements in existing projects, and should support the other areas of the company in the preparation of equipment and specific versions for demonstrations, fairs and presentations.
  • Prepare reports so that everyone is aligned on the status of developments, according to the processes and frameworks used by DFS for project management and new product development.
  • Coordinate SW releases to the field and provide support afterwards.
  • Train internal and external support teams, as well as DFS manufacturing areas in new products or versions that generate significant changes.
  • Create, maintain and disseminate the KPIs of the area.
  • Promote innovation, review and continuous improvement of the team's processes seeking process improvements, reduction of operating costs and maintenance of systems.
  • Document and assist in the implementation of processes that support the manufacturing, testing and quality control process of the equipment that involves our software/hardware solutions.
  • Monitor and support internal and external audit processes (ISO).
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.


Instruction

Complete higher education in Computer Engineering or related areas.


Specific Knowledge

  • Advanced/fluent English and Spanish;
  • Programming language: C# and XML;
  • Knowledge of cryptography;
  • Device connection (TCP, Serial, etc);
  • Knowledge of network (wired, wireless, routers, etc.);
  • Domain in Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Desirable

  • Development and integrations of payment methods -
  • Jira;
  • TeamCity;
  • GITHub;
  • Confluence;
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc;.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.


We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. title: DevOps Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (AWS) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

Assistência Médica

description:
About the job


1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!


2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.

  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.

  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.


4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST com FastAPI (Python).

  • Automatizar pipelines de build, teste e deploy, mantendo padrões de qualidade e segurança.
  • Fazer deploy em Azure Cloud, garantindo consistência entre Test, UAT e Production.


4. Quality Assurance & Testing

  • Criar testes automatizados com Pytest e garantir execução no pipeline de CI.

  • React;

Onde você vai trabalhar


No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: NetSuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.


MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.


Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.



Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;

title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
MISSÃO DO CARGO

Ser o elo entre dados e decisões, garantindo que as informações da empresa se transformem em conhecimento estratégico e ações concretas. A pessoa nesta posição será responsável por estruturar, tratar e traduzir dados complexos em análises claras, confiáveis e orientadas ao negócio, contribuindo para elevar a maturidade analítica da organização e apoiar times na tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Estruturar e tratar dados oriundos de múltiplas fontes, garantindo integridade, padronização e confiabilidade;
  • Construir consultas SQL e pipelines de dados para alimentar relatórios e dashboards;
  • Desenvolver análises exploratórias e diagnósticos para identificar causas, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Criar e manter painéis de visualização que comuniquem claramente indicadores e insights de negócio;

  • Promover a evolução da maturidade analítica e disseminar boas práticas de governança de dados;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as equipes de processos e sistemas para estruturar dados e automatizar fluxos;
  • Manter documentação atualizada sobre origens de dados, lógicas de tratamento e regras de cálculo.


CONHECIMENTOS E HABILIDADES

  • Domínio em SQL (obrigatório): construção de queries complexas, manipulação e tratamento de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de visualização;
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados (conceitual e relacional);
  • Conhecimentos em Python ou outra linguagem para análise e automação (desejável);
  • Entendimento de conceitos de governança, qualidade e integração de dados;
  • Capacidade de interpretar contextos de negócio e traduzir em hipóteses analíticas.


Se você quer atuar em projetos desafiadores, com liberdade para propor soluções e contribuir na construção de produtos de alto desempenho, essa vaga é para você!

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar conjuntos de dados e modelos analíticos para relatórios e dashboards interativos no Power BI;

Requisitos e Certificações:

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia e análise de dados, com domínio de Power BI, Azure Data Factory e Data Warehousing;

Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:
