Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.


What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests: Rapidly learn product/domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites: Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation: Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI/CD quality gates: Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging/preproduction environments and in production once deployed.
  • Own defect lifecycle: Identify, document, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and impact.
  • Data & API validation: Test APIs, validate payloads and contracts (e.g., via Swagger/OpenAPI ), and verify database outcomes (SQL Server ).
  • Non-functional checks: Contribute to performance baselines (e.g., k6 , JMeter ), and security test coordination.
  • Test strategy & traceability: Maintain risk-based test plans, coverage maps, and traceability to requirements/ACs.
  • Mentor & improve: Share best practices, pair on tests, and improve standards for reliability, maintainability, and observability of tests.


Must Have Qualifications

  • Software quality assurance experience, including extensive manual testing and test case design.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining automated tests in .NET (C#) for UI and/or API layers.
  • Strong understanding of .NET/.NET Core , ASP.NET (MVC/Web API) fundamentals, HTTP, and JSON.
  • Hands-on with Selenium and/or Playwright , plus NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ; experience.
  • Comfortable reading application code, using Visual Studio /Visual Studio Code , debugging tests, and collaborating on testability.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, boards/issues, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.

Education

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading AI engineering teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions
  • Strong technical depth in AI/ML, cloud platforms, and agentic system design
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, drive clarity, and influence across functions
  • Passion for building transformative AI systems that solve meaningful problems

title: Analytics Engineering Senior
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Você fará parte do time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais.

O time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais atua de forma transversal na companhia em projetos de alto potencial de impacto financeiro explorando métodos estatísticos e de aprendizagem de máquina. Estamos em busca de um profissional especialista em Ciência de Dados com experiência comprovada para impulsionar nosso crescimento e inovação através da utilização eficiente e impactante dos dados.


Seu papel:

Seu dia a dia será assim:

  • Modelar dados para atender necessidades específicas das áreas de negócio.
  • Construir produtos de dados centrados no usuário (pipelines, indicadores, dashboards).
  • Desenvolver modelos, tabelas e relatórios que representem a "fonte da verdade" (Gold/Diamond - arquitetura medalhão) .
  • Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados em múltiplas plataformas, assegurando a precisão dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Suportar a implantação e utilizar o catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos de dados, garantindo as políticas de governança.
  • Promover o uso estratégico dos dados na resolução de problemas de negócio.


O que esperamos de você:

  • SQL Avançado: Proficiência em SQL, com habilidade para escrever e otimizar consultas complexas.
  • Modelagem e Pipelines: Experiência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT (e.g., Azure Data Factory ou similares).
  • Visão Analítica: Habilidades analíticas e estatísticas, com capacidade de aplicar técnicas para resolver problemas de negócios.
  • Ferramentas: Conhecimento em Python para análise de dados (PySpark é um diferencial) e ferramentas de análise (Metabase, Power BI).
  • Soft Skills: Orientação para resultados , foco em alcançar metas e melhorar os processos de negócios.


O que pode te destacar:

  • Domínio do Databricks para engenharia, análise e ciência de dados.
  • Experiência comprovada com Governança de Dados e aplicação prática do Unity como Catálogo de Dados no Databricks.
  • Experiência prática com modelos de LLM ou aplicação de processamento de linguagem natural.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.

  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.

  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.

title: Técnico em segurança do trabalho
description:
Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore (HSE Technician)

Local: Offshore



Sobre a posição


Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore (HSE Technician) para atuar em nossas unidades marítimas.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a aplicação das normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente a bordo, apoiando auditorias, treinamentos e a gestão de riscos operacionais.


Responsabilidades


  • Elaborar e executar programas de prevenção de acidentes e ações de saúde e meio ambiente;

  • Monitorar a validade dos equipamentos de combate a incêndio e acompanhar obras e adequações de instalações;
  • Apoiar a gestão do SGI (Sistema de Gestão Integrado) e auditorias de conformidade;
  • Reportar situações críticas que possam afetar a segurança da unidade;
  • Promover a cultura de segurança, saúde e proteção ambiental junto às equipes.


Requisitos


  • Formação técnica completa em Segurança do Trabalho ;
  • Registro ativo no conselho profissional ;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos na função;

  • Inglês intermediário a avançado ;
  • Disponibilidade para escala offshore 14x14 .

  • Curso CBSP ou BOSIET STCW ;
  • HUET – Helicopter Underwater Escape Training ;
  • NR-37 Básico – Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho na Plataforma (online) .


Perfil desejado

  • Dinâmico, proativo e atento aos detalhes;
  • Comprometido com segurança e conformidade;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de trabalho em equipe;
  • Cumprimento rigoroso das normas operacionais.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Hartmann Young is partnered with a fast-growing global leader in health, nutrition, and wellness ingredients, known for its science-led innovation and rapid international expansion. As the business continues to scale, we are seeking a dynamic Business Development Manager South America to drive immediate commercial impact and elevate the company’s presence across the nutraceutical market.


We’re looking for someone who brings genuine industry influence, including:

  • A strong book of business and established relationships with brand owners, CMOs/CDMOs, and major consumer health companies
  • Proven success selling key nutraceutical dosage forms — tablets, capsules, softgels, and gummys.


If you’re commercially driven, well-connected, and excited by the opportunity to shape partnerships in a high-growth environment, this role offers an exceptional platform to make a meaningful and immediate impact.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business growth by leveraging your existing network and opening high-value commercial opportunities
  • Develop and expand strategic partnerships with global key accounts, brand owners, distributors, and contract manufacturers
  • Lead the full business development cycle — from opportunity identification to negotiation and long-term strategic planning
  • Translate scientific and technical capabilities into compelling commercial propositions
  • Collaborate closely with R&D, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to deliver integrated go-to-market strategies
  • Manage contracts, commercial terms, and performance optimisation across partnership lifecycles
  • Support international expansion through new market development and strategic alliances
  • Represent the business at leading industry trade shows and events to strengthen brand visibility and network reach.


Key Requirements

  • You can be located anywhere within South America to qualify for this market.
  • 8+ years’ experience in business development, partnerships, or commercial leadership within nutraceuticals, ingredients, food, or life sciences within South America.
  • A well-established book of business and strong relationships across the nutraceutical ecosystem
  • Direct experience selling tablets, capsules, softgels, gummys, or related dosage forms
  • Proven ability to generate revenue growth and close complex commercial agreements
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to convert technical innovation into business value
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth, hands-on environment
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.
  • Validate data integrity through SQL queries and support backend testing.
  • Troubleshoot issues by analyzing logs, debugging test failures, and collaborating closely with development teams.
  • Work with JIRA for requirement management and defect tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate across global teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience with Selenium , including locators, waits, and driver configuration.
  • Strong experience in REST API testing, including JSON/XML validation, HTTP verbs, Postman, and Swagger.
  • Good experience with Java , including control structures, exception handling, and database queries.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, including DML, joins, and basic schema definitions.
  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber , including writing feature files and step definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work with distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of software testing best practices, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Allure reporting.
  • Background in test strategy definition or QA process improvements.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices or willingness to learn.
  • Experience in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
About the Company

Diib is a company based out of Salt Lake City, Utah. Diib’s mission is to make internet marketing clearer for individuals who don’t know anything about it. Diib helps small and medium businesses to find new ways to grow with Actionable Analytics, Industry-Based Ranking, and Custom Learning Tracks. 250k websites use Diib. The product is AI for SEO and other internet marketing aspects.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software, ensuring robust system performance, and driving automation best practices. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end testing strategies, leveraging Python for comprehensive test automation across functional, non-functional, and white-box testing. You will also play a key role in maintaining monitoring systems to proactively identify issues in production environments.


Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable end-to-end (E2E) tests using Python, Playwright, and Pytest for both UI and API validation.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to support continuous delivery and provide fast feedback.
  • Implement and manage test data and environments to ensure reliable and repeatable test execution.

Test Planning & Strategy

  • Design, document, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define quality benchmarks and ensure test coverage for all requirements.

Functional and Non-Functional Testing

  • Execute detailed automated and manual tests across multiple platforms and devices to validate functionality, usability, and performance.
  • Ensure that systems meet reliability, scalability, and availability expectations, especially in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .

White-box Testing

  • Work closely with developers to understand internal logic and architecture, enabling more effective code-level testing.
  • Utilize Python scripts to facilitate unit, integration, and service-level testing beyond traditional black-box methods.

Monitoring System Configuration

  • Manage application and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Establish alerts and dashboards to support proactive issue resolution and maintain uptime.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing.
  • 3+ years of proficiency in Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
  • Demonstrable experience with modern testing frameworks/tools like Playwright and Pytest for effective and reliable E2E and API testing.
  • Proven experience working with and testing applications deployed in a Cloud Environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .
  • Solid experience setting up and maintaining test execution within CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) .
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Good knowledge of SQL is a must.
  • Familiarity with modern monitoring platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, or similar).
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.


Nice to have

  • Proficiency in performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).
  • Experience in testing data pipelines or data warehouse solutions , particularly Amazon Redshift .
  • Familiarity with testing applications built on AI/ML platforms , such as AWS Bedrock (e.g., prompt validation, knowledge base testing, or guardrail evaluation).


What We Offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

  • Collaboration with an innovative design and development team using cutting-edge tools.
  • Flexible work environment focused on learning, iteration, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

Copywriting and editing skills

title: Sr Python Data Engineer
description:
Senior Python Data Engineer

About the Project


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance data processing pipelines using Python libraries (Pandas, Polars).
  • Develop and expose RESTful APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Consume and process normalized Parquet files from multiple upstream sources to generate dynamic Excel reports.
  • Contribute to a spec-driven development workflow (using GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to scaffold and generate API/data pipeline code.
  • Optimize report generation logic for speed and scalability, currently targeting sub-20 second response times.
  • Integrate with messaging and storage mechanisms (e.g., Service Bus, Storage Accounts).
  • Collaborate on infrastructure-as-code automation using Bicep (or similar IaC tools).

  • Strong proficiency in Python for data processing (must have expertise in Pandas, nice to have: Polars, openpyxl).
  • Experience building backend services or APIs using frameworks like FastAPI.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling principles (Star Schema) and handling normalized datasets.
  • Familiarity with enterprise messaging patterns and data integration from various sources (API-based and file-based).
  • Experience working with GitHub and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Bicep or comparable tools (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Comfort with spec-driven development and leveraging AI tools like GitHub Copilot for scaffolding.

title: Software Architect .NET
description:

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

title: Game Compliance e Development Consultant
description:
SOBRE A NÓS:

A DigiPlus Interactive Corp., líder em entretenimento digital nas Filipinas, chegou ao Brasil! Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2025 com o lançamento oficial da DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda., e já estamos 100% licenciados para oferecer experiências inovadoras no mercado de iGaming.

Contrato PJ temporário (3 meses) podendo ser extendido, necessário inglês avançado para atuação global.


Irá fornecer consultoria especializada para garantir que os jogos proprietários da DigiPlus (bingo, jogos instantâneos e jogos esportivos) estejam em total conformidade com as regulamentações de jogos brasileiras e tecnicamente prontos para certificação por laboratórios acreditados (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, etc.). Atuará na intermediação entre a interpretação da regulamentação, a validação matemática e a localização para o Brasil, possibilitando uma rápida implementação comercial.


ENTREGÁVEIS ESPERADOS DA CONSULTORIA:

Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações

  • Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas.
  • Desenvolver e entregar um Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade, resumindo as lacunas e as adaptações necessárias.
  • Elaborar ou revisar a documentação técnica para submissão aos laboratórios de certificação (regras, metodologia de RNG, tabelas de RTP, lógica de pagamento).
  • Recomendar melhorias no fluxo de trabalho para agilizar a preparação para a certificação e minimizar retrabalho.


Matemática e Validação de Jogos

  • Revisar e validar os modelos matemáticos do jogo: RTP, volatilidade, curvas de pagamento e lógica de probabilidade.
  • Executar ou supervisionar simulações e testes A/B para verificar os resultados matemáticos esperados.
  • Produzir um Resumo de Validação Matemática, identificando inconsistências, riscos e ajustes recomendados.


Localização e Adaptação ao Mercado

  • Avaliar os recursos do jogo quanto à adequação cultural e comportamental ao mercado brasileiro (visuais, UX, ritmo e terminologia).
  • Fornecer um Documento de Diretrizes de Localização que descreva os ajustes necessários para melhorar o engajamento do usuário e a conformidade.
  • Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais.


Suporte Interfuncional

  • Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade.
  • Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos.


RESULTADOS ESPERADOS:

  • Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto).
  • Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática.
  • Documento com Diretrizes de Localização.
  • Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação.
  • Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos.


REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos.
  • Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação.
  • Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade.
  • Inglês Avançado (necessário para lidar com Stakeholders global)


O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado de iGaming;
  • Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:

Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de machine learning utilizando técnicas de classificação, regressão e clusterização;
  • Realizar testes de modelos de machine learning, incluindo, mas não se limitando a, testes A/B, testes de hipótese e validação cruzada;
  • Proficiente em feature engineering para otimizar os desempenhos dos modelos desenvolvidos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis;
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning em cima da plataforma databricks;
  • Manutenção de modelos existentes (Acompanhamento e eventuais retreinamentos) ;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias de dados para identificar padrões e tendências relevantes;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de práticas de MLOps..

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Machine Learning | Regressão, Classificação, Clusterização, Redes Neurais, Seleção de Features, Cross-Validation, "Curse of Dimensionality", Viés-Variânica, Explicabilidade de Modelos, etc;

  • Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar scrips e queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;
  • Data Modeling | Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;
  • Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;

  • MLOps básico | para entender os desafios de se colocar um modelo em produção;
  • Experimentação | Testes A|B, Hipóteses, Modelos de Atribuição;
  • Grandes Volumes | Extrair e manipular grandes bases de dados, utilizando a stack de dados disponível.


FERRAMENTAS

  • SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;
  • Python ou R | Pra quando a coisa fica bem séria;
  • Scala, Java & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;
  • Teste de Hipóteses | Para suportar o processo de tomada de decisão e criar informação de suporte;

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist to support our client’s Paid Media team. You’ll ensure every digital advertising campaign is tracked accurately and consistently, building and maintaining the infrastructure behind performance measurement. This includes configuring, QA’ing, and troubleshooting tracking systems—mainly via Google Tag Manager (GTM)—to ensure data integrity and accurate attribution.


By partnering closely with Paid Search Specialists and Account Strategists, you’ll help eliminate inaccurate conversion data, improve ROI reporting, and enable smarter optimization decisions across 60+ client accounts.

  • Implement, QA, and maintain tags, triggers, and pixels in Google Tag Manager (GTM) across client websites.

  • Validate conversion actions to ensure form fills, purchases, or other lead events are correctly recorded, avoiding inflated reporting.
  • Standardize and document tagging schemas for all client accounts in Salesforce, ensuring consistent fields (budget, KPIs, goals, tracking status).
  • Partner with Paid Search Specialists to align conversion actions and budgets with each client’s true business objectives.
  • Create and maintain a tracking QA checklist and intake form to guide new account setups and audits.
  • Perform ongoing health checks of all tracking infrastructure to proactively identify broken tags or discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with the client’s marketing team to recommend scalable intake and QA processes (e.g., onboarding forms, Salesforce automation).
  • Produce clear documentation for all tagging and data validation processes to ensure team-wide continuity.


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience managing Google Tag Manager (tag creation, testing, triggers, version control).
  • Solid understanding of conversion tracking across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid media platforms.
  • Hands-on experience validating data layers, debugging tags, and testing event triggers in browser consoles.
  • Strong ability to QA campaign tracking and identify discrepancies between actual and reported performance data.
  • Demonstrated experience creating or maintaining documentation (SOPs, QA templates, checklists).
  • Excellent communication skills to partner with account managers, strategists, and technical teams.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems for marketing data management.
  • Understanding of enhanced conversions, consent mode, and privacy-related tagging.
  • Exposure to GA4 or other analytics platforms for event-based measurement.
  • Experience supporting agencies managing high-volume client portfolios.
  • Prior experience collaborating with web developers or marketing analysts on data validation and tag troubleshooting.


Durable Skills

  • Highly detail-oriented, precise, and methodical in QA and documentation.
  • Process-driven mindset—capable of building repeatable tagging and validation frameworks.
  • Problem-solving mentality with a focus on scalable solutions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ownership mentality with a focus on accuracy, quality, and reliability.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in your career. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager – Sustainability

Location: Brazil- Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

BSI is seeking an experienced and strategic Business Development Manager (BDM), Sustainability to maintain and grow relationships with large, strategically important clients. You will coordinate BSI’s global efforts to deliver assurance solutions focused on sustainability, greenhouse gas (GHG) verification, reduction, and neutrality.

In this role, you will lead account planning, achieve sales targets by expanding existing accounts and securing new business, and provide thought leadership within the sustainability space. You will also support sales initiatives across the Americas and actively engage in industry events.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Achieve assigned sales targets and drive profitable revenue growth.
  • Develop and manage relationships with strategic accounts and senior business leaders.
  • Retain existing accounts through ongoing engagement and partnership with operational teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand BSI’s sustainability client base.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, integrating requirements into operational delivery.
  • Support other sales professionals in selling sustainability and GHG audit services.
  • Collaborate with global marketing, product development, and sales teams on priorities and initiatives.
  • Participate in industry associations, conferences, and events to provide thought leadership.
  • Conduct account health checks, review pricing annually, and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning and customer service.
  • Analyze market conditions, competitors, and customer insights to enhance sales performance.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quimical engineer or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience in solutions sales and business development.
  • Experience selling assessment or audit solutions within professional services.
  • Proven ability to engage senior-level management and manage multinational client relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce (preferred).
  • Strong skills in communication, persuasion, relationship-building, and performance monitoring.


Career opportunities are vast with around 5,000 employees working with over 82,000 clients in 182 countries. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve sustainable growth.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization, all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Technical Writer
description:
Overview: Algoseek is seeking a Technical Writer – Financial Documentation to create clear, structured, and comprehensive documentation for our datasets and APIs. This role requires both technical precision and financial knowledge, turning complex data and APIs into content that is accurate, accessible, and client-friendly. You will work closely with developers, data engineers, and product teams to ensure consistency, clarity, and usability across all documentation.


Role Details:

  • Location: 100% Remote (Global Team)
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Competitive, with additional growth opportunities


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain clear, accurate, and structured documentation for financial APIs, datasets, and schemas.
  • Create detailed descriptions of datasets, fields, parameters, and references with consistent terminology.
  • Explain complex financial concepts (market data, instruments, indicators) in simple, client-friendly language .
  • Provide usage examples (sample queries, API calls, JSON responses) for APIs and datasets.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and product managers to gather technical details.
  • Define and enforce documentation standards, style guides, and consistency across products.
  • Continuously improve documentation based on feedback from clients and internal teams.


Essential Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Technical Writer, Data Documentation Specialist, or related role .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, datasets, data models, and JSON structures .
  • Background in finance or trading , with knowledge of instruments, market data, or financial reporting.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to simplify complex technical and financial concepts.
  • Ability to structure and organize large sets of documentation logically and consistently .
  • Skilled at collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data, QA).


Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience with API documentation tools (e.g., OpenAPI).
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools and metadata management.
  • Basic knowledge of Python .
  • Understanding of developer experience and user-centered documentation design.
  • Prior work in fintech, data providers, or market intelligence platforms .
  • Ability to create visual aids (ER diagrams, data flow charts, architecture overviews).


Work Hours:

  • Flexible remote setup with required availability for critical U.S. market overlap hours . (fixed EST hours – 9 to 1PM)
  • Occasional late-evening coverage for key delivery periods.


What Success Looks Like

  • Clear, structured documentation that makes complex datasets and APIs accessible .
  • Consistent terminology and standards across all technical content .
  • Documentation that improves client adoption and reduces support overhead.
  • Positive feedback from internal teams and external clients on clarity and usability.


Why Join Algoseek?

  • Work with a leading provider of high-quality market data and trading solutions.
  • Collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and financial experts.
  • Drive innovation in automated trading systems and distributed market data solutions.
  • Be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team with a culture of ownership and excellence.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive monthly compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
  • A 100% remote work setup with flexibility for work-life balance.
  • An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an innovative, fast-paced market data company.
  • Professional development opportunities to help you grow into higher leadership roles.
  • If you’re a skilled finance professional ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you! Please send your resume and a brief overview of your background and availability.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro
description:
Analista de Planejamento Financeiro


Descrição de Atividades:

Responsável pelo apoio nas rotinas de planejamento financeiro para suportar a condução do ciclo orçamentário, o acompanhamento do orçamento (real x orçado x forecast), a elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, a revisão de projeções, a realização de análises de investimentos e a preparação de apresentações executivas para garantir a execução das rotinas da área de planejamento financeiro e indiretamente apoiar decisões na empresa.


Atividades:

1. Auxiliar na atualização das projeções, modelagens e estimativas de demonstrativos financeiros para guiar em variados cenários as estratégias, através da atualização das ferramentas de Projeção de Fluxo de Caixa, de DRE, e do Balanço Patrimonial. Irá participar de reuniões com outras áreas e gestor para definição das premissas a serem consideradas em análises de estresses e na análise do cenário base para os demonstrativos financeiros;


2. Auxiliar nas análises de propostas comerciais e aprimorar a ferramenta de precificação para garantir a correta estimativa dos resultados esperados da proposta, aprimorando a planilha de precificação, sempre que solicitado, atualizando a ferramenta a cada demanda nova de precificação e validando com o gestor as premissas que foram apresentadas pelos demais departamentos para a formação de preço com o objetivo de assegurar a correta precificação da proposta comercial;


3. Preparar, assegurar, aprimorar e desenvolver gráficos, análises e slides para apresentações internas e executivas (Comitês e Conselho), por meio de Relatórios, propondo slides ou análises, criando gráficos; buscando informações com outras áreas, garantindo a assertividade e qualidade das informações a serem apresentadas;


4. Auxiliar na condução do ciclo orçamentário anual, através do desenvolvimento das planilhas de preenchimento orçamentário, compartilhando com os gestores, consolidando as planilhas recebidas e atualizando as ferramentas de análises e modelo de projeção orçamentária;


5. Realizar e aprimorar as análises dos resultados e percepção de desvios nos resultados das operações. Atualizando as ferramentas de análise do Realizado x Orçado x Forecast, propondo novas formas de análise e apresentação dos resultados para donos de pacotes e gestores da empresa;


6. Contribuir para elaboração de análises histórica por empresa através do desenvolvimento e atualização das ferramentas com base de dados históricas que permitam analisar a performance da empresa e dos ativos por indicadores operacionais, de rentabilidade, de liquidez, de endividamento ou outros indicadores para apoiar análises de benchmarking interno ou externo;


7. Auxiliar demais gestores nas análises de Real x Orçado através do desenvolvimento de ferramentas, indicadores, relatórios para donos de pacotes garantindo a correta análise e explicação dos desvios com o objetivo de facilitar as revisões das projeções.


Formação necessária:

Área: Economia, Engenharia, Administração e Contabilidade

  • Necessário ter conhecimento avançado em Excel e Power BI.

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.


Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
  • Expand Judi, our web-based enterprise health platform, using Python, AWS services, React/Typescript, and other technologies.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.


Preferred Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.


What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work.


This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).


About the Role


We are seeking a talented NetSuite Software Developer who is passionate about building scalable, high-performing applications that integrate seamlessly across business systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React, or Angular) , NodeJS backend development , and experience scripting within NetSuite . This position requires both creativity and technical depth to develop integrations, APIs, and dynamic web interfaces while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.


Responsibilities


  • Front-End Development: Build modern, responsive front-end interfaces using Vue.js (or similar frameworks such as React or Angular).
  • Back-End Development: Develop and maintain robust NodeJS services that handle data integration and automation.
  • API Integration: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful API endpoints that connect enterprise systems.
  • System Integration: Create and manage integrations between NetSuite and third-party platforms such as Business Central , QuickBooks Online , and Salesforce .
  • NetSuite Scripting: Develop and maintain SuiteScript solutions to enhance NetSuite functionality and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, designers, and other developers to solve complex technical challenges and ensure successful delivery.
  • Innovation: Continuously explore new technologies and methods to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability across systems.


Requirements:


  • Develop and maintain backend systems using Node.js and modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, Angular, or React).
  • Design and implement APIs, integrations, and backend logic for enterprise solutions.
  • Work with third-party APIs and enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Candidates must have a strong foundation in NetSuite , either as a Functional Consultant or Technical Consultant .


Nice to Have


  • Familiarity with accounting concepts or financial software.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (NetSuite, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
